CVE-2018-1000654.title: libtasn1: Infinite loop in _asn1_expand_object_id(ptree) leads to memory exhaustion
CVE-2018-1000654.description: A vulnerability was found in GNU Libtasn1, where a resource management issue can lead to a denial of service, here an attacker could exploit this flaw by persuading a victim to parse a specially crafted file, exhausting all available CPU resources.
